# Job 5 — Group 02C detailed explanation revision

Target: Chapters/Nursing-Foundations/MCQs/02C-Clinical-Handover-and-Team-Communication-26-MCQs.md. Source blob 6461daf67c5b0c1fa1689a0e0c747e43b94a4ff5. Draft for existing questions, not a new question bank.

## Q1 — key C

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

SBAR mein S ka matlab Situation hai. Call receive karne wale clinician ko sabse pehle pata chalna chahiye ki kaunse patient ke baare mein baat ho rahi hai aur abhi call kyun ki ja rahi hai. Example ke liye nurse approved patient identifiers ke saath bataye ki patient ki breathing achanak deteriorate hui hai. Isse receiver urgency samajhkar appropriate response organize kar sakta hai. Acute emergency mein communication ke saath immediate safety actions bhi shuru hone chahiye.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A possible diagnoses ka exhaustive list Situation ka purpose nahi hai. Relevant interpretation Assessment mein aati hai.
- **B:** B discharge plan current abrupt deterioration nahi batata.
- **C:** C patient identification aur immediate concern dono clear karta hai.
- **D:** D remote history ka relevant part Background mein aata hai, poori history nahi.

**Exam clue:** S = who and what is happening now.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q2 — key B

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Background ka matlab woh relevant clinical context hai jo present concern samajhne mein help karta hai. Nurse recent operation, main diagnosis, important medications, allergies aur recent treatment ya baseline findings mein se case-relevant information select kare. Example ke liye postoperative breathlessness mein recent surgery aur mobility restriction useful context ho sakte hain. Irrelevant detail urgent message ko unnecessarily long bana sakti hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A receiver ka confirmation closed-loop verification hai, Background nahi.
- **B:** B current concern ko explain karne wali relevant history deta hai.
- **C:** C requested bedside review Recommendation hai.
- **D:** D current findings ki interpretation Assessment hai.

**Exam clue:** B = relevant context before the current event.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q3 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Assessment mein nurse current findings ko organize karke clinical concern batati hai. Example ke liye respiratory rate, oxygen saturation aur level of consciousness mein change ko report karke nurse respiratory deterioration ka concern express kar sakti hai. Yeh definitive medical diagnosis claim karna nahi hai. Uncertainty ho toh clearly communicate karo aur clinical urgency ke according escalation karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A present data aur clinical interpretation ka correct component hai.
- **B:** B Background earlier context deta hai, present interpretation nahi.
- **C:** C Recommendation mein desired next action ya request batayi jaati hai.
- **D:** D Situation immediate problem introduce karti hai, detailed interpretation Assessment mein hoti hai.

**Exam clue:** A = current findings plus what they may mean.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q4 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Urgent communication mein receiver ko exact request aur urgency samajh aani chahiye. Vague hint se receiver assume kar sakta hai ki issue routine hai. Nurse concise clinical evidence dekar immediate review request kare. Agar patient unstable hai toh local emergency response pathway activate karo. Sirf request bhejkar wait karna sufficient nahi, response aur further escalation ensure karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A action aur timing dono unclear hain.
- **B:** B receiver ko poora chart dhoondhne ke liye kehna focused urgent communication nahi hai.
- **C:** C response absent hone ko safety confirmation samajhna dangerous hai.
- **D:** D immediate review ka clear request aur concern deta hai.

**Exam clue:** Recommendation should specify action and urgency.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q5 — key B

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Check-back mein sender message deta hai, receiver relevant content repeat karta hai aur sender us repetition ki accuracy confirm karta hai. Example mein numerical result repeat aur verify hua. Isse wrong digit, unit ya instruction mishear hone ka risk kam hota hai. Agar mismatch ho toh correct information dekar loop repeat karna chahiye.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A silent acknowledgment actual content verify nahi karta.
- **B:** B repeated content aur sender confirmation closed loop banate hain.
- **C:** C one-way broadcast mein receiver feedback nahi hota.
- **D:** D teach-back patient ya caregiver ki understanding check karta hai, yahan professional team exchange hai.

**Exam clue:** Check-back = send, repeat, confirm.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q6 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Incorrect repeat-back ek useful warning hai ki message sahi tarah transfer nahi hua. Sender ko correct instruction clearly repeat karni chahiye aur receiver se fresh repeat-back lena chahiye. Dose, units, patient identity ya time-sensitive action mein uncertainty especially important hai. Confirmed shared understanding ke bina task ko verified mat samjho.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A misunderstanding correct karke renewed confirmation leta hai.
- **B:** B sirf repeat hona accuracy ka proof nahi hai.
- **C:** C wrong message ko verified document karna unsafe aur inaccurate hai.
- **D:** D silent change receiver ke mental model ko update nahi karta.

**Exam clue:** Wrong repeat-back means reopen the loop.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q7 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Call-out ka purpose important finding ko simultaneously responding team tak pahunchana hai. Emergency mein nurse critical observation aloud communicate kar sakti hai taaki team next action anticipate kare. Task assign karte waqt specific responsible member identify karna useful hai. Critical task ke liye acknowledgment aur completion communication bhi zaroori ho sakti hai. Patient privacy aur local protocol ko situation ke according maintain karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A discharge summary emergency team ko real-time alert nahi deti.
- **B:** B counselling usually individual therapeutic conversation hai.
- **C:** C charting by exception ek documentation method hai.
- **D:** D urgent shared information ko team tak pahunchane wala call-out hai.

**Exam clue:** Call-out informs many team members at once.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q8 — key C

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Emergency mein generic request jaise koi yeh kaam kar do se confusion ho sakta hai ki kaun karega. Specific role ya name ke saath assignment aur recipient ka acknowledgment responsibility clear karte hain. Recipient action complete karke result ya difficulty report kare. Leader overall coordination maintain karta hai. Task delegation competence aur authorized scope ke according honi chahiye.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A acknowledgment later result reporting ko eliminate nahi karta.
- **B:** B communication required documentation ka replacement nahi hai.
- **C:** C explicit ownership missed aur duplicated task ka risk reduce karti hai.
- **D:** D particular task assignment permanent transfer of all accountability nahi hai.

**Exam clue:** Assign, acknowledge, perform, report.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q9 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

I-PASS structured handoff ka I illness severity hai. Ismein patient stable hai, closer watch ki zaroorat hai ya unstable hai, woh concise form mein communicate kiya jaata hai. Receiver ko monitoring aur urgency prioritize karne mein help milti hai. Category ko actual assessment se support karo aur deterioration ko label ke peeche hide mat karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A clinical stability category describe karta hai.
- **B:** B Action list remaining tasks aur responsibility batati hai.
- **C:** C synthesis mein receiver apni understanding verify karta hai.
- **D:** D summary clinical course aur care context deta hai.

**Exam clue:** I = Illness severity.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q10 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Action list mein woh tasks aate hain jo receiving clinician ko complete ya follow up karne hain. Pending lab, repeat vital signs ya scheduled treatment ke liye task, due time aur responsible role clear karo. Example ke liye pending result ko kaun check karega aur abnormal result par kya action hoga, ye clarify karo. Handover ke baad task miss hone ka risk isse kam hota hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A unrelated childhood history outstanding task nahi hai.
- **B:** B stable label illness severity hai, task list nahi.
- **C:** C receiver repetition synthesis hai.
- **D:** D outstanding tasks, timing aur ownership clear karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Action list = what, when, who.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q11 — key C

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Situation awareness ka matlab patient ki current condition aur possible changes ko anticipate karna hai. Contingency plan mein specific warning sign aur uske develop hone par expected response clarify karte hain. Example ke liye patient-specific worsening symptoms par reassessment aur approved escalation pathway activate karne ka plan. Generic instruction se urgent response delay ho sakta hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A notes read karne ko kehta hai lekin trigger aur next action specify nahi karta.
- **B:** B outgoing nurse ka wait receiving team's responsibility delay karta hai.
- **C:** C clear warning sign aur appropriate escalation plan deta hai.
- **D:** D stable patient bhi deteriorate ho sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Contingency = if this happens, do that.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q12 — key B

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Synthesis by receiver handoff ka active verification step hai. Receiving nurse main concern, priority tasks aur responsibility apne words mein summarize karti hai. Sender misunderstanding correct kar sakta hai aur receiver missing details pooch sakti hai. Yeh sirf yes bolne se stronger shared understanding create karta hai. Written documentation aur approved handover record phir bhi maintain hote hain.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A clarification synthesis ka important benefit hai, unnecessary nahi.
- **B:** B understanding aur task ownership verify karta hai.
- **C:** C original plan ignore karne ka authorization nahi milta.
- **D:** D written record aur safety documentation ki need remain karti hai.

**Exam clue:** Last S = synthesis by receiver.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q13 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Infusion handover mein current medication ya fluid identity, concentration as applicable, prescribed rate, pump settings, line and access status aur monitoring needs verify karo. High-alert infusion mein local independent double-check policy follow karo. Orders aur actual pump setting mismatch ho toh approved safe process se resolve aur escalate karo. Label color par depend karne se wrong medication ya rate error ho sakta hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A color standard verification ke liye sufficient nahi hai.
- **B:** B purchase date current prescribed setting nahi batati.
- **C:** C ward equipment count patient therapy verify nahi karta.
- **D:** D therapy identity, rate, access aur monitoring cover karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Verify order against actual infusion and patient.

**Dedicated clinical policy reference: verification pending.**

</details>

## Q14 — key C

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Isolation precaution pathogen aur transmission risk ke basis par decide hoti hai, room location ke basis par nahi. Transfer ke pehle receiving team ko applicable precaution, PPE requirement aur placement arrangement communicate karo. Transport ke dauran relevant precautions follow karo. Only necessary information authorized staff ko share karo, privacy maintain karte hue infection risk manage karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A location change se infection risk automatically end nahi hota.
- **B:** B confidentiality authorized care team ko required safety information dene se nahi rokti.
- **C:** C transfer se pehle precaution aur receiving readiness verify karta hai.
- **D:** D arrival ke baad discovery exposure aur delay cause kar sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Precautions travel with the patient's relevant care needs.

**Dedicated clinical policy reference: verification pending.**

</details>

## Q15 — key B

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Allergy handover mein exact substance aur known reaction verify karna important hai. Nausea jaisa adverse effect aur anaphylaxis jaisi serious hypersensitivity same nahi hain, lekin uncertain report ko independently delete mat karo. Patient, record aur authorized team se clarification lo. Suspected allergen exposure avoid karne aur urgent treatment decision ke liye facility policy follow karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A reaction hone tak wait prevention fail karta hai.
- **B:** B allergen aur reaction details clarify aur verify karta hai.
- **C:** C uncertain allergy silently remove karna unsafe hai.
- **D:** D allergy reaction type aur severity vary kar sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Unknown reaction is a reason to clarify, not erase.

**Dedicated clinical policy reference: verification pending.**

</details>

## Q16 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Transfer ke time oral intake order missing ho toh receiving nurse ko latest authorized order verify karna chahiye. Restriction aspiration risk, procedure preparation ya other condition se related ho sakti hai. Unsafe oral intake avoid karo while promptly resolving discrepancy. Confirmed restriction aur review timing team aur patient ko communicate karo. Unnecessary prolonged restriction bhi dehydration ya discomfort cause kar sakti hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A current orders reconcile karke confirmed restriction communicate karta hai.
- **B:** B routine meal schedule patient-specific restriction override nahi karta.
- **C:** C every transferred patient ke liye normal intake safe assume nahi kar sakte.
- **D:** D indefinite restriction without review unnecessary harm kar sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Reconcile conflicting orders before implementing care.

**Dedicated clinical policy reference: verification pending.**

</details>

## Q17 — key C

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Frequent nonurgent interruptions handover mein important information bhoolne aur incomplete task transfer ka risk badhati hain. Protected time, designated location aur clear coverage arrangement se routine interruptions reduce ki ja sakti hain. Genuine urgent concern ke liye exception hona chahiye, kyunki patient emergency handover se bhi higher priority le sakti hai. Interrupted report ko resume karte waqt last point verify karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A unstable patients omit karna highest-priority information lose karta hai.
- **B:** B unreviewed list receiver questions aur acknowledgment replace nahi karti.
- **C:** C protected process plus emergency exception balance karta hai.
- **D:** D all interruptions prohibit karna emergency response delay kar sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Protect handover, allow true emergencies.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q18 — key B

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Bedside handover patient involvement improve kar sakta hai, lekin sensitive information public ya shared space mein reveal nahi karni chahiye. Patient ki wishes aur consent clarify karo, authorized receiving staff ko relevant details appropriate private channel se communicate karo. Confidentiality ka purpose unauthorized disclosure prevent karna hai, necessary safe care information suppress karna nahi.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A corridor public space ho sakta hai aur privacy risk remain karta hai.
- **B:** B private communication aur required clinical information dono preserve karta hai.
- **C:** C standardized format privacy need override nahi karta.
- **D:** D clinically relevant information receiving team se hide karna safety compromise kar sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Private handoff for sensitive content, not omission.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q19 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Patient apne routine function, preferences aur baseline assistance ke baare mein valuable information de sakta hai. Discrepancy sunne ke baad nurse current mobility assessment, prescribed restrictions aur care plan verify kare. Patient ka input respect karo aur safe confirmed assistance level document aur communicate karo. Unverified change ke saath transfer ya walking shuru karna fall risk badha sakta hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A patient input acknowledge karke current plan validate karta hai.
- **B:** B patient ko dismiss karna potential error correction miss karta hai.
- **C:** C clinical restrictions check kiye bina statement follow karna unsafe ho sakta hai.
- **D:** D staff convenience safe mobility assessment replace nahi karti.

**Exam clue:** Patient participation adds evidence, verification makes it safe.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q20 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Secure message send hone ka matlab task accept ya complete hona nahi hai. Time-sensitive work ke liye correct receiver, receipt, understanding aur ownership confirm karo. Acknowledgment na aaye toh approved alternate communication ya escalation route use karo. Actual completion aur result later verify karo. Unrelated accounts ko message bhejna privacy breach aur confusion cause kar sakta hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A delivery ko action ka proof assume karta hai.
- **B:** B wrong recipients ko message karna confidentiality aur task confusion badhata hai.
- **C:** C message sent hona completed care ka evidence nahi hai.
- **D:** D receipt aur responsibility confirm karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Sent does not mean received, accepted or completed.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q21 — key B

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Unfamiliar patient ka handoff incomplete ho toh facts aur uncertainty clearly separate karo. Patient identifiers, immediate clinical status, allergies, critical orders aur pending high-risk tasks prioritize karke verify karo. Jo information missing hai usko guess mat karo. Receiving team ke saath outstanding checks aur responsibility agree karo. Urgent transfer ko every minor detail ke liye unnecessary delay mat karo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A unrelated template wrong-patient information introduce kar sakta hai.
- **B:** B known facts, unknowns aur follow-up ownership transparent karta hai.
- **C:** C plausible assumption ko factual information bana deta hai.
- **D:** D all information withhold karna timely care continuity delay karta hai.

**Exam clue:** State known, unknown and who will verify.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q22 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Persistent serious clinical concern ko first dismissal ke baad ignore nahi karna hai. Nurse objective findings, change from baseline aur urgency clearly restate kare aur facility-approved escalation pathway use kare. Patient reassessment aur appropriate emergency support continue kare. TeamSTEPPS advocacy aur two-challenge principles safety concern ko professional manner mein raise karne mein help karte hain. Actual local response route policy ke according hoga.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A evidence-based concern repeat karke further escalation karta hai.
- **B:** B ongoing deterioration ke bawajood dismissal accept karna unsafe hai.
- **C:** C next shift ka wait time-sensitive harm increase kar sakta hai.
- **D:** D personal insults se clinical issue resolve nahi hota.

**Exam clue:** Speak up with facts, escalate unresolved safety concerns.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q23 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Pending consultation ek unfinished responsibility hai. Handover mein consultant request ka reason, status, expected review timing aur responsible clinician clarify karo. Agar consultation delay ho ya patient deteriorate kare toh agreed escalation plan use karo. Receiver acknowledgment ensure karta hai ki task kisi ke responsibility mein hai. Patient ko informed rakho, par clinical coordination ka entire burden us par mat daalo.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A implicit ownership diffusion of responsibility create kar sakti hai.
- **B:** B patient ko all clinical follow-up independently coordinate karwana appropriate substitute nahi hai.
- **C:** C pending task remove karne se continuity information lose hoti hai.
- **D:** D ownership, timing aur escalation clear karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Every pending task needs an owner and deadline.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/overview/index.html)

</details>

## Q24 — key C

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Brief planned activity ke pehle short team discussion hai. Team members roles, objective, equipment, staffing aur anticipated risks review karte hain. Complex procedure se pehle yeh shared mental model banata hai. Safety checklist aur formal time-out ki local requirements phir bhi follow karni hoti hain. Brief ka purpose preparation hai, retrospective review nahi.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A discharge counselling patient education ke liye hoti hai.
- **B:** B incident investigation event ke baad cause explore karti hai.
- **C:** C planned action se pehle team coordination karta hai.
- **D:** D debrief activity ke baad performance review karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Brief = before.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/resources/modules/index.html)

</details>

## Q25 — key A

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Huddle care ke dauran short team meeting hai jab situation change ho aur existing plan revise karna zaroori ho. Unexpected workload, staffing issue ya deteriorating patient ke time priorities, resource allocation aur task ownership reassess karte hain. Huddle immediate emergency treatment ko delay nahi karna chahiye. Updated plan clear communicate aur acknowledge karvao.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A changing situation ke according real-time replanning karta hai.
- **B:** B individual patient orientation team coordination replace nahi karti.
- **C:** C annual appraisal immediate unit priority solve nahi karti.
- **D:** D post-event debrief current action ke liye late ho sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Huddle = during, when the plan needs adjustment.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/resources/modules/index.html)

</details>

## Q26 — key D

<details><summary>Proposed detailed Hinglish explanation</summary>

Debrief activity ya event ke baad structured reflection hai. Team review karti hai kya effective raha, kya communication gap hua aur next time kaunsi practical safeguard improve kar sakti hai. Discussion factual aur learning-oriented honi chahiye. Required clinical documentation aur formal incident report ka replacement nahi hai. Agreed improvement actions ko follow up karna important hai.

**Option-by-option reasoning**

- **A:** A brief planned activity ke pehle hota hai.
- **B:** B call-out current critical finding communicate karta hai.
- **C:** C teach-back patient ki understanding evaluate karta hai.
- **D:** D completed activity ke baad team performance review karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Debrief = after, learn and improve.

[Concept reference](https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/resources/modules/index.html)

</details>
